title: Lumbar range of motion in six directions, normal-weight young males (Vicon)
condition: healthy normal-weight males, standing, maximal voluntary motion

quantity.name: range of motion
quantity.definition: thorax relative to pelvis (total lumbar rotation) at maximal voluntary motion, deg

source.sample: 18 young healthy males: 9 normal-weight (BMI 23.9 SD 1.3) and 9 age/height-matched obese (BMI 35.3 SD 2.6); no recent back pain

protocol.summary: Normal-weight young males performed maximal voluntary motion in all six directions; lumbar RoM from Vicon Euler angles (Fig 5).
how_to_use: Use these lumbar ranges as the end-of-range targets of the normal-weight group for each of the six directions (from upright).
Decompose the trunk angle at full range as trunk = pelvis + lumbar (flexion: 51.1 + 71.1 = 122.2 vs 122.4 deg measured, normal-weight).
For intermediate trunk angles apply the interval L/P ratios (kinematics.ghasemi2021.lp_ratio_*).
Obesity: lumbar flexion ~9 deg smaller and pelvis right lateral bending ~5 deg larger (only significant differences, p<=0.05); other directions are not different.

measurement.device: 10-camera Vicon, Plug-in-Gait markers + thoracic (C7,T10,CLAV,STRN) and pelvic (ASIS/PSIS) clusters; XYZ Euler angles of thorax and pelvis vs lab, lumbar = thorax relative to pelvis
measurement.posture: standing, knees extended, no feet pivoting
measurement.task: maximal voluntary flexion, extension, right/left lateral bending, right/left axial rotation from relaxed upright standing, unloaded

protocol.notes: Values read from bar chart; SD = half the distance between the two error-bar caps (both caps detected for all bars). Text checks: trunk flexion ~122/115, lumbar flexion ~71/62, pelvis axial rotation ~55/60, trunk extension ~48/48, pelvis lateral bending ~9/13 deg (normal/obese) – all consistent.

extraction.check_notes: Re-digitised with a second method (column scan of bar top and error-bar line ends): all means within 0.2 deg; sum pelvis+lumbar matches trunk within 0.3 deg for flexion in both groups.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
